Import Boilerplate Database with JSON Support

Source: R/json-support.R
boilerplate_import_json.Rd

Enhanced version of boilerplate_import that supports JSON files in addition to RDS format. Automatically detects file format when format="auto".

Usage

boilerplate_import_json(
  category = NULL,
  data_path = NULL,
  format = "auto",
  quiet = FALSE
)

Arguments

category

Character vector of categories to import. Options include "methods", "results", "discussion", "measures", "appendix", "template". If NULL, imports all categories.

data_path

Path to data directory containing database files. Defaults to "boilerplate/data" in current project.

format

Format preference ("auto", "json", "rds"). When "auto", tries JSON first, then falls back to RDS if JSON not found.

quiet

Logical. Suppress messages? Default is FALSE.

Value

A unified database list with all imported categories

See also

boilerplate_import, boilerplate_save_json

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Import all categories from JSON files
db <- boilerplate_import_json(format = "json")

# Import specific categories
db <- boilerplate_import_json(category = c("methods", "measures"))

# Auto-detect format
db <- boilerplate_import_json(format = "auto")
} # }
